flags.claim: Benji Dillon threw 150.1 innings with 65 walks. That is 3.9 walks per nine and 2.03 strikeouts per walk, at an ERA of 4.43.
flags.issue: Direct contradiction of recorded sports state: Ground truth C116/C114 explicitly records Benji Dillon's 2041 season line as 140.2 IP, 56 BB, 120 SO, and a 4.61 ERA (9-8 record, 2.0 WAR), not 150.1 IP, 65 BB, or 4.43 ERA.

summary: Benji Dillon 2041 season statistics contradict canonical ground truth (140.2 IP, 4.61 ERA, 56 BB).
